connector.name: Solana MCP by Vybe by vybenetwork (vybenetwork-vybe-solana-api)
connector.registryDescription: Solana MCP for wallets, trades, markets, PnL, transfers, onchain data, signable swaps and API tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at docs.vybenetwork.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vybenetwork account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-KEY
headers.description: API key for authenticated Solana API calls (get yours at https://vybe.fyi)
